blurb: Diamond Dance Works offers a variety of dance classes including ballet, tap, jazz, hip hop, acro, lyrical, contemporary, and specialty classes for ages from 12 months to adults. They have a Ballet Conservatory program for serious ballet students with auditions and advanced training. Classes run year-round with seasonal schedules and include recital participation options.
extraNote: Tuition due on 27th of each month, non-refundable, auto pay required. · Late fee of $15 if payment not received by 1st of month. · 30-day written notice required for cancellation. · Costume fee $85 per class due November 6th for recital participants, $100 after deadline. · Media fee $25 per family for recital photos and videos, due March 17th. · No refunds for tuition, costume, or media fees after payment. · No parents allowed in classroom; live feed available in lobby. · Late pickup fee $1 per minute after studio closing time.
